name: gizza-ai/json-yaml-convert
summary: Convert between JSON, YAML, and TOML

tool.description: Convert config data between JSON, YAML, and TOML in any direction. Specify from and to (json/yaml/toml); pretty indents JSON/TOML output (default true). Note: TOML output requires a top-level object and has no null. Round-trips data through a common model. Runs locally.
